hero.title: The shortest path to volume production.
hero.subtitle: Avoid custom RF and power management. Use our pre-engineered System-on-Modules (SOMs) for your edge AI deployments.

features.heading: Stop Routing. Start Shipping.
features.subtitle: Spinning a custom PCB with extreme space and power constraints takes months of trial and error. We solved the hardware physics so you can focus entirely on your application logic.

cards.title: Microwatt AI in a Micro Footprint
cards.description: We pre-routed the GPX10 AI processor and wireless stacks into high-density footprints. Skip RF certification nightmares and achieve scale.

cards.title: Purpose-Built Peripherals
cards.description: Simplify sourcing and driver integration. Each SOM is pre-integrated with the sensors and interfaces your vertical needs—vision, telemetry, or acoustics.

cards.title: 1:1 Code Portability
cards.description: The exact C-code, AI object files, and unified Eclipse build you validated on the Cranium Evaluation Kit ports directly to any of our production SOMs with zero rewrites.

ecosystem.heading: The Ambient SOM Ecosystem
ecosystem.subtitle: Purpose-built edge modules. Validate your software on our evaluation kits today, and drop our SOMs directly into your final product tomorrow.

inside_module.heading: Inside the Sparsh AI Module
inside_module.subtitle: Bridge the lab and real world. The Sparsh module offers continuous, microwatt intelligence in a 21×21mm size, with a breakout board that snaps off for production.
inside_module.label: The Hardware Blueprint

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Optimized for months of inference on a CR2032 coin-cell.

specs.label: Comms & I/O
specs.value: Onboard BLE, SPI, I2C, and UART interfaces

prototype.heading: Prototype to Product in a Snap

cards.title: The Lab
cards.description: Use the integrated breakout board for rapid prototyping. It includes a USB-C port for charging, a 10-pin JTAG connector, programmable LEDs, and headers for easy signal probing and power analysis.

cards.title: Production-Ready SOMs
cards.description: Once your software is validated, simply snap off the breakout half. The remaining 21×21mm core module embeds directly into your space-constrained product with zero hardware redesign required.

intelligence.heading: Out-of-the-Box Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: A seamless toolchain is useless if hardware can't integrate. Move from software validation to deployment instantly with our modular edge ecosystem.

cards.title: Motion & Fall Detection
cards.description: Leverage the 6-axis IMU for microwatt-level continuous activity recognition and instant fall detection.

cards.title: Voice Identity & Commands
cards.description: Run continuous wake-word and secure voice authentication locally via the Knowles digital mic.

cards.title: Acoustic Anomalies
cards.description: Deploy models for health monitoring (like asthma/cough detection) or security (assault detection) entirely on-device, preserving user privacy.

cards.title: Safety & Geofencing
cards.description: Utilize the onboard BLE and processing technology to trigger instant localized alerts when boundaries are breached.

ready_to_deploy.heading: Ready to deploy?
ready_to_deploy.subtitle: Start building with the Sparsh module today, or secure your place in line for our upcoming vertical-specific SOMs.
ready_to_deploy.secondary_text: Start testing motion and audio models on the metal immediately.

footer_merge.heading: Join the SOM Waitlist
footer_merge.subtitle: Be the first to access our upcoming Vision, Sound, and Industrial modules.
